name: Promexa – Promo Box for Elementor
author: Kartik chavda

sections.description:
Promexa – Promo Box for Elementor adds a powerful and flexible promo box widget to Elementor.

Create modern UI blocks with:
– Background images
– Overlay effects
– Badges (corner, circle, flag)
– Hover animations
– Custom content & buttons

Lightweight and optimized for performance.

Features

  • Multiple layout styles
  • Image + background support
  • Overlay & hover effects
  • Badge system (corner, circle, flag)
  • Fully responsive
  • Clean and optimized code
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open Elementor editor
  4. Search for “PBFE Promo Box”
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor must be installed and activated.

Is it compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes.
